content.text:
Create an SVG logo for a generative AI company using organic shapes and neutral tones

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result, so
  ./output/ holds those finished image/video files and nothing else.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep the code you write to make the files in the working directory (its root, or a subdirectory
  like ./src/, but not in ./output/): it's published as the source. Delete intermediate files such
  as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generative AI logo — organic shapes, neutral tones.
Brand: ōra  (from 'organic' + 'era' / 'aura') — generative intelligence studio
Outputs 3 SVGs to ./output/
"""
import os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)

# Neutral palette
CREAM   = "#F4F0E9"
STONE   = "#E6DED3"
TAUPE   = "#C9B8A6"
CLAY    = "#A99B8A"
OLIVE   = "#8A847B"
CHARCOAL= "#23201D"
WARMGREY= "#6B655E"
LIGHT   = "#DAD2C6"

MARK = """
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="g1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D8CFC0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B8A99A"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="g2" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8A847B"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#23201D"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- generative bloom mark: three organic petals + growth dots -->
  <g transform="translate(200,200)">
    <!-- petal left-bottom -->
    <path d="M -8,62 C -72,58 -108,12 -96,-38 C -85,-84 -38,-96 2,-72 C 34,-53 32,-8 18,28 C 11,47 3,64 -8,62 Z" fill="url(#g1)"/>
    <!-- petal right (charcoal) -->
    <path d="M 10,62 C 68,58 104,14 96,-34 C 88,-80 44,-98 6,-76 C -22,-60 -22,-16 -6,26 C 0,44 2,63 10,62 Z" fill="#23201D"/>
    <!-- petal top-center (overlap, creates lens) -->
    <path d="M 0,-12 C -28,-52 -18,-104 12,-114 C 44,-124 70,-88 58,-48 C 48,-16 22,2 0,-12 Z" fill="#E6DED3" stroke="#23201D" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <!-- inner seed -->
    <circle cx="2" cy="18" r="13" fill="#F4F0E9"/>
    <circle cx="2" cy="18" r="5.5" fill="#23201D"/>
    <!-- generative nodes trailing like spores / data points -->
    <circle cx="58" cy="-92" r="5" fill="#23201D"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="-72" r="3.2" fill="#A99B8A"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="-98" r="2.2" fill="#C9B8A6"/>
    <path d="M 48,-78 Q 62,-84 58,-92 M 66,-78 Q 76,-76 82,-72" stroke="#A99B8A" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>
"""

def primary():
    return f'''<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="640" viewBox="0 0 1200 640" role="img" aria-label="ora generative AI logo">
  <rect width="1200" height="640" fill="{CREAM}"/>
  <!-- subtle organic background blobs -->
  <path d="M 920,40 C 1020,20 1120,90 1100,190 C 1082,278 960,300 900,240 C 840,180 830,60 920,40 Z" fill="{STONE}" opacity="0.55"/>
  <path d="M 60,520 C 140,500 210,540 200,600 C 192,642 80,650 40,610 C 6,576 -10,538 60,520 Z" fill="{STONE}" opacity="0.5"/>
  {MARK}
  <!-- wordmark -->
  <g transform="translate(360,0)" fill="{CHARCOAL}">
    <text x="0" y="238" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" font-size="118" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="-2">ōra</text>
    <text x="4" y="292" font-family="Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" letter-spacing="5.5" fill="{WARMGREY}">GENERATIVE INTELLIGENCE</text>
    <line x1="4" y1="322" x2="420" y2="322" stroke="{TAUPE}" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="4" y="356" font-family="Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15.5" letter-spacing="0.4" fill="{WARMGREY}">Grown, not built — AI that evolves with you.</text>
  </g>
  <text x="600" y="595" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" letter-spacing="3" fill="#B8A99A">ORGANIC  •  NEUTRAL  •  GENERATIVE</text>
</svg>'''

def icon():
    # centered icon on cream rounded square - app icon / favicon use
    return f'''<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="800" height="800" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-label="ora icon">
  <rect width="400" height="400" rx="88" fill="{CREAM}"/>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="380" height="380" rx="80" fill="none" stroke="{STONE}" stroke-width="1"/>
  {MARK}
</svg>'''

def mono():
    mark_mono = MARK.replace('url(#g1)', CHARCOAL).replace('#E6DED3', CREAM).replace('#23201D', CHARCOAL)
    # simpler: rebuild mono mark inline
    mark_mono = f'''
  <g transform="translate(170,170)">
    <path d="M -8,62 C -72,58 -108,12 -96,-38 C -85,-84 -38,-96 2,-72 C 34,-53 32,-8 18,28 C 11,47 3,64 -8,62 Z" fill="none" stroke="{CHARCOAL}" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <path d="M 10,62 C 68,58 104,14 96,-34 C 88,-80 44,-98 6,-76 C -22,-60 -22,-16 -6,26 C 0,44 2,63 10,62 Z" fill="{CHARCOAL}"/>
    <path d="M 0,-12 C -28,-52 -18,-104 12,-114 C 44,-124 70,-88 58,-48 C 48,-16 22,2 0,-12 Z" fill="{CREAM}" stroke="{CHARCOAL}" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="2" cy="18" r="6" fill="{CHARCOAL}"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="-92" r="5" fill="{CHARCOAL}"/><circle cx="82" cy="-72" r="3" fill="{CHARCOAL}"/>
  </g>'''
    return f'''<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1000" height="360" viewBox="0 0 1000 360" role="img" aria-label="ora mono logo">
  <rect width="1000" height="360" fill="white"/>
  {mark_mono}
  <g fill="{CHARCOAL}">
    <text x="300" y="178" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" font-size="92" letter-spacing="-1">ōra</text>
    <text x="304" y="218" font-family="Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" letter-spacing="5" fill="{WARMGREY}">GENERATIVE INTELLIGENCE</text>
  </g>
</svg>'''

open("output/logo-primary.svg","w").write(primary())
open("output/logo-icon.svg","w").write(icon())
open("output/logo-mono.svg","w").write(mono())
print("written")
for f in sorted(os.listdir("output")):
    print(f, os.path.getsize(f"output/{f}"))

import zlib, struct, math

W=H=800
# canvas cream
px = [[(244,240,233)]*W for _ in range(H)]

def cubic(p0,p1,p2,p3,n=40):
    pts=[]
    for i in range(n+1):
        t=i/n; u=1-t
        x=u**3*p0[0]+3*u*u*t*p1[0]+3*u*t*t*p2[0]+t**3*p3[0]
        y=u**3*p0[1]+3*u*u*t*p1[1]+3*u*t*t*p2[1]+t**3*p3[1]
        pts.append((x,y))
    return pts

def blob(segments):
    pts=[]
    for s in segments: pts+=cubic(*s)
    return pts

def fill(pts,color):
    # translate: mark center at 400,400 scale 2
    pts=[(400+x*2,400+y*2) for x,y in pts]
    ys=[p[1] for p in pts]; y0,y1=int(min(ys)),int(max(ys))
    for y in range(max(0,y0),min(H,y1+1)):
        xs=[]
        for i in range(len(pts)):
            x1,y_1=pts[i]; x2,y2=pts[(i+1)%len(pts)]
            if (y_1<=y<y2) or (y2<=y<y_1):
                xs.append(x1+(y-y_1)/(y2-y_1)*(x2-x1))
        xs.sort()
        for i in range(0,len(xs)-1,2):
            for x in range(max(0,int(xs[i])),min(W,int(xs[i+1])+1)):
                px[y][x]=color

def circle(cx,cy,r,color):
    cx,cy=400+cx*2,400+cy*2; r*=2
    for y in range(int(cy-r),int(cy+r+1)):
        for x in range(int(cx-r),int(cx+r+1)):
            if 0<=x<W and 0<=y<H and (x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2<=r*r: px[y][x]=color

# paths from SVG (relative to mark origin)
left=[((-8,62),(-72,58),(-108,12),(-96,-38)),((-96,-38),(-85,-84),(-38,-96),(2,-72)),((2,-72),(34,-53),(32,-8),(18,28)),((18,28),(11,47),(3,64),(-8,62))]
right=[((10,62),(68,58),(104,14),(96,-34)),((96,-34),(88,-80),(44,-98),(6,-76)),((6,-76),(-22,-60),(-22,-16),(-6,26)),((-6,26),(0,44),(2,63),(10,62))]
top=[((0,-12),(-28,-52),(-18,-104),(12,-114)),((12,-114),(44,-124),(70,-88),(58,-48)),((58,-48),(48,-16),(22,2),(0,-12))]

fill(blob(left),(201,184,166))
fill(blob(right),(35,32,29))
fill(blob(top),(230,222,211))
circle(2,18,13,(244,240,233)); circle(2,18,5.5,(35,32,29))
circle(58,-92,5,(35,32,29)); circle(82,-72,3.2,(169,155,138)); circle(92,-98,2.2,(201,184,166))

def write_png(path):
    raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+b''.join(struct.pack('BBB',*px[y][x]) for x in range(W)) for y in range(H))
    def chunk(t,d):
        c=struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d; return c+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    png=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',W,H,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
    open(path,'wb').write(png)
write_png('output/logo-icon.png')
print('png ok')

    c1 = CHARCOAL if mono else TAUPE
    c2 = CHARCOAL if mono else CHARCOAL
    c3 = CHARCOAL if mono else STONE
    fill3 = "none" if mono else STONE
    return f'''
  <g transform="translate({cx},{cy}) scale({scale})">
    <g transform="rotate(-28)"><path d="{PETAL}" fill="{c1}"/></g>
    <g transform="rotate(92)"><path d="{PETAL}" fill="{c2}"/></g>

</svg>'''

  <rect width="400" height="400" rx="88" fill="{CREAM}"/>

- `logo-mono.svg` — single-colour version for print / embossing
